newsitem.title: UK: Woolwich keeps interest rates under review.
newsitem.headline: Woolwich keeps interest rates under review.

text.p: Britain's Woolwich Building Society, the country's fifth largest mortgage lender, said on Tuesday it will keep its interest rates under review.

"Today's announcement was expected. The Woolwich will be keeping its interest rates under review to ensure they are competitively priced," said a spokesman for the homelender shortly after Britain's new Labour government ordered an increase in interest rates to 6.25 percent from 6.0 percent.
The Halifax, Britain's largest building society is expected to make a statement in the next half an hour.
